title: Joshua
summary: Joshua is dated in Raleigh's chronological table (1617), column Israel, by a yeere of the World. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person.
description: Added from the Raleigh import (The History of the World, 1617). Raleigh is display-only. He gives a yeere of the World, not a BC year, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only and is not converted to BC.

reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 784b
reign.note: Year cell "3236 2554 41". The third printed figure 41 is the column "Exodus", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 18 at the end of the name is the reign length he prints. The end year is not printed on this row. Column: Israel..

reign.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 99; Julius Africanus, in the editor's biographical notice (the notice says it is abridged from Bunsen)
reign.note: Editor's summary in the biographical notice, which says it is abridged from Bunsen. Not a verbatim fragment. The year of the world is left in the quotation. It is not stored and it is not converted.

reign.citation: Hales, A New Analysis of Chronology and Geography, History and Prophecy, 2nd ed., corrected and improved (London: C. J. G. & F. Rivington, 1830), vol. II, Synopsis of the Chronology, p. xxxiv
reign.note: The elders on this line have no separate record.
